name: Weapon Binder (Warmage Archetype)
body:
Weapon binders are a specific tradition of warmages that eschew some of their tactical expertise with a deep bond with a weapon that they excel with and that defends them.

Weapon Bond (Ex)

At 1st level a weapon binder gains proficiency with a simple or martial melee weapon.

They also begin play with a masterwork version of the chosen weapon at no extra cost. If the weapon binder attempts to cast a warmage spell without the weapon on their person or in their hand, they must attempt a concentration check (DC 20 + the spell’s level) or lose the spell.

Additionally, the bonded weapon can be used once per day to cast any one spell that the weapon binder has in their spellbook and is capable of casting, even if the spell is not prepared. This spell is treated like any other spell cast by the weapon binder, including casting time, duration, and other effects dependent on the warmage’s level. This spell cannot be modified by metamagic feats or other abilities.

The weapon binder can add enhancements to this weapon as any other masterwork weapon as if they have the required item creation feat, so long as they meet the level requirements of the feat.

If the bonded weapon is damaged, it is restored to full hit points the next time the weapon binder prepares their spells. If the bonded weapon is lost or destroyed, it can be replaced after 1 week in a special ritual that costs 200 gp per warmage level plus the cost of the masterwork weapon. This ritual takes 8 hours to complete. Weapons replaced in this way do not possess any of the additional enchantments of the previous bonded weapon. A weapon binder can designate an existing magic weapon as their bonded weapon, so long as they are proficient. This acts the same way as replacing a lost or destroyed item except that the new magic weapon retains its abilities while gaining the benefits and drawbacks of becoming a bonded weapon.

This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 1st level.

Striking Weapon (Su)

At 3rd level, a weapon binder can send their bonded weapon to strike their foes. They gain the hand of the apprentice ability of the universalist wizard school, but can use that ability only with their bonded weapon. Their range with the ability is close (25 feet + 5 feet per 2 warmage levels they possess), and they can use it a number of times per day equal to 3 + their Intelligence modifier + 1/2 their warmage level. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 3rd level.

Spell-Delivering Weapon (Su)

At 5th level, whenever a weapon binder casts a spell with a range of touch from their warmage spell list, they can use their bonded weapon to deliver the touch attack, including expending a daily use of striking weapon to make the touch attack at range. This occurs as part of the same action as casting the spell. They gain all the attack bonuses that apply to their bonded weapon, including enhancement bonuses and relevant feats, but do not add their weapon’s damage or effects to the touch spell.

Even though the attack is made with the weapon, it remains a touch attack. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 5th level.

Spell-Striking Weapon (Su)

At 9th level, when a weapon binder casts a ranged touch spell or activates striking weapon to cast a touch spell at range through it, they can deliver the spell and strike the target in one motion. Rather than a touch attack, they make a ranged attack with the bonded weapon, with no penalty for using a melee weapon as an improvised ranged weapon. If the weapon hits, it deals normal weapon damage for striking weapon ability and the spell automatically hits that target. If the weapon misses, the spell lingers on it and the weapon binder can attempt to deliver the spell again by activating this ability as a standard action. If the weapon binder drops or sheaths the weapon with the spell’s charge still held, the charge dissipates to no effect. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 9th level.
